title: Microsoft Teams: streaming switchboard for NDI sources in meetings and events
summary: The briefing's rollout dates, NDI prerequisites and policy controls match Microsoft's notice and documentation. The checklist names the user-side Production capabilities control, but that control has no row in the controls table; this is a minor completeness finding.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing
claims.claim: Teams is adding a streaming switchboard for sending NDI sources from meetings and events to production software.
claims.quote: For Teams meetings and events, a new streaming switchboard will soon be available to easily manage and send NDI sources out to production software.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: Event producers can individually select and stream up to eight NDI sources.
claims.quote: Event producers can individually select and stream up to eight NDI sources directly from a Teams meeting or event.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: During a meeting or event, producers access More actions > Streaming > Streaming switchboard.
claims.quote: To access the feature during a meeting or event, select More actions, then Streaming > Streaming switchboard.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Scope; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: Administrators must enable NDI streaming before users can use the feature.
claims.quote: Admins must enable NDI streaming before users can use the feature.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Users must turn on production capabilities in Teams after an administrator enables NDI streaming.
claims.quote: After an admin enables NDI streaming, users must turn on production capabilities in Teams.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: risk and impact

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls: rendered table
claims.claim: The Teams admin center path is Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Audio & video > Broadcast production with NDI and SDI hardware.
claims.quote:
go to **Meetings** > **Meeting policies**.
2. Select an existing policy or create a new one.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: rendered table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell supports Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowNDIStreaming $true to enable NDI.
claims.quote: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell module; [-AllowNDIStreaming <Boolean>]; This parameter enables the use of NDI technology to capture and deliver broadcast-quality audio and video over your network. -Identity: Specify the name of the policy being created.

claims.claim: Learn advises against enabling the broadcast production policy as a global setting.

claims.quote: Users with an enabled **Broadcast production with NDI and SDI hardware** policy must turn on **Production capabilities** from **Settings** > **App Permissions** in their specific client.

claims.where: summary; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: No licence specific to the streaming switchboard is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams NDI broadcast production streaming switchboard license licensing pricing Teams Premium; opened use-ndi-in-meetings and teams-service-description; read Teams Premium licensing search excerpts. No switchboard-specific licence found.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has published no switchboard-specific price or charge.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Teams streaming switchboard NDI licence price charge meter; Teams NDI broadcast production streaming switchboard license licensing pricing Teams Premium; opened use-ndi-in-meetings and teams-service-description. No switchboard price or meter found.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the streaming switchboard itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Teams streaming switchboard NDI documentation existing enabled policy changes Production capabilities admin control; opened use-ndi-in-meetings. Results describe existing NDI production, not the switchboard.

claims.where: Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described additional changes for tenants that already enable AllowNDIStreaming.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams NDI streaming switchboard Production capabilities admin policy user setting autonomous existing policies rollout changes; opened use-ndi-in-meetings and read MC1521613. Neither describes additional changes to already-enabled tenants.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: MC1521613 says its provided source does not specify management through Entra ID group membership.
claims.quote: The provided source does not specify whether the control can be managed through Entra ID group membership.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: No autonomous switchboard behaviour is described; the sources describe producer selection.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams NDI streaming switchboard Production capabilities admin policy user setting autonomous existing policies rollout changes; opened use-ndi-in-meetings and read roadmap and MC1521613. The notice describes producers selecting sources, not autonomous actions.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: The NDI Learn page's PowerShell prose names ContentSharingInExternalMeetings, while its script uses AllowNDIStreaming.
claims.quote:
You can use the **`-ContentSharingInExternalMeetings`** parameter ... to enable broadcast production for your users.
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowNDIStreaming $true

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: The documented Production capabilities client step is performed by each user, with no administrator policy for that user step shown in the cited pages.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams NDI streaming switchboard Production capabilities admin policy user setting autonomous existing policies rollout changes; opened use-ndi-in-meetings, settings-policies-reference and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy. The client step is user-operated; no admin equivalent found.

claims.where: controls[0].scope and note; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: AllowNDIStreaming in a user's Teams meeting policy controls NDI broadcast production and is the notice's administrator control for this switchboard.
claims.quote: Enable AllowNDIStreaming for the appropriate users through the CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet. ... Admins can control NDI® streaming through the AllowNDIStreaming setting in CsTeamsMeetingPolicy.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; controls
claims.claim: The checklist tells producers to set Production capabilities, but the controls table has no row for that client control.
claims.quote: Tell producers to turn on Production capabilities under Settings > App Permissions before they try the switchboard. The sole controls row is: Whether users can use NDI and SDI broadcast production in meetings.
claims.fix: The At rollout bullet 'Tell producers to turn on Production capabilities under Settings > App Permissions before they try the switchboard' names a control without a table row. Remove that checklist bullet; retain the verified user prerequisite and path in Scope.
